evidence.text:
Our roots took hold in the heart of Texas during a time when the industry's potential had yet to fully bloom. Now, over a half century later, Willow Bridge and our 6,000+ team members have grown to be one of the largest multifamily managers in the United States, with over 240,000 units under management. Plus, we’re one of the nation’s largest multifamily developers, developing over 200,000+ units over the years, with more communities on the horizon.

Founded in 1965 in Dallas, TX - Willow Bridge (formerly Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has seen it all when it comes to residential real estate. Throughout the decades, Willow Bridge has developed over 200,000 units and today manages 200,000 units and has $3B in investment AUM.

Following Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s purchase of the residential division of the company, we unveil a new name and brand. Today, Willow Bridge manages over 180,000 apartment units and eyes even more growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding marketplace. With $3B in investments under management and over $1B currently under development, the sky is the limit.

Lincoln Property Company’s residential division appears on the inaugural NMHC Top 50 list as the second largest multifamily manager with 80,706 units under management and the fourth largest multifamily developer with 63,206 units owned in 1990.

LINCOLN PROPERTY COMPANY REACHES 100,000 UNITS UNDER MANAGEMENT

With a legacy spanning decades, our purposeful journey continues. Since our inception in 1965, Willow Bridge (previously known as Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has been led and operated by visionaries who have created, managed, and stewarded exceptional residential communities all across America.

Lincoln’s residential division launched a $1.8B investment fund with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP) and Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO). The focus of the fund is on the development and acquisition of high quality multifamily assets in top US markets.

evidence.title: Our Promise | Our Mission
evidence.text:
Willow Bridge Property Company

Whether you’re an investor looking to expand your portfolio, a team player that is looking for career growth, or a person simply looking to start a new chapter in one of our apartment homes, Willow Bridge is here to support you. Our mission is to deliver impeccable service with integrity and give you the resources you need to thrive and feel empowered. Build a partnership with us today.

We act with our entire community in mind. Investors. Clients. Employees. Residents. Everyone has a role. We create the best resident experience, providing comfort like the iconic sheltering willow tree. We enable growth, community, and exchange like the suspension bridge that stands the test of time as a symbol of human ingenuity and drive. We do it because we care about building great relationships. With the cities, towns, and communities we belong to: we’re good corporate citizens. With clients and partners: we transform the trust and resources they place with us into growth that we can all benefit from. With the people who let us into their homes: we’re the best at service.

We are accountable for ensuring our neighbors are happy in their homes and take ownership of any problems that may arise.

We are Willow Bridge. We’re more than a full-service residential real estate company. For over half a century, we’ve been the standard of excellence in the property industry. As the residential team at Lincoln Property Company we built a stellar reputation, leading with bold, transformative ideas, principled partnership, and a care for the details that only comes from loving what you do. We’re rooted in commitment and expertise built from decades of experience. We’re headed toward an ambitious future where we consistently create new avenues for success. Standing together on a powerful legacy, each of us can see what’s ahead – a great investment, an incredible career, an experience of home no one else can provide.

As industry leaders with over 60 years of professional property management, development and investment experience, we can help you grow your real estate investment to new heights. Learn more about our services.

Our talented and experienced team defined what forward-thinking property management could be, and our company grew dramatically. Fast-forward to today, and our well-oiled machine has truly redefined the industry. While we’re always looking ahead, we can’t help but reminisce about our early days and the milestones reached along the way…

sources.title: Apartment Rentals & Property Management
sources.excerpt:
Our roots took hold in the heart of Texas during a time when the industry's potential had yet to fully bloom. Now, over a half century later, Willow Bridge and our 6,000+ team members have grown to be one of the largest multifamily managers in the United States, with over 240,000 units under management. Plus, we’re one of the nation’s largest multifamily developers, developing over 200,000+ units over the years, with more communities on the horizon.

Founded in 1965 in Dallas, TX - Willow Bridge (formerly Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has seen it all when it comes to residential real estate. Throughout the decades, Willow Bridge has developed over 200,000 units and today manages 200,000 units and has $3B in investment AUM.

Following Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s purchase of the residential division of the company, we unveil a new name and brand. Today, Willow Bridge manages over 180,000 apartment units and eyes even more growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding marketplace. With $3B in investments under management and over $1B currently under development, the sky is the limit.

Lincoln Property Company’s residential division appears on the inaugural NMHC Top 50 list as the second largest multifamily manager with 80,706 units under management and the fourth largest multifamily developer with 63,206 units owned in 1990.

LINCOLN PROPERTY COMPANY REACHES 100,000 UNITS UNDER MANAGEMENT

With a legacy spanning decades, our purposeful journey continues. Since our inception in 1965, Willow Bridge (previously known as Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has been led and operated by visionaries who have created, managed, and stewarded exceptional residential communities all across America.

Lincoln’s residential division launched a $1.8B investment fund with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP) and Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO). The focus of the fund is on the development and acquisition of high quality multifamily assets in top US markets.

Lincoln’s residential division tops 100,000 multifamily units under management in 1997, according to the National Multifamily Housing Council (NMHC) as the third largest management company in the United States. Lincoln Property Company’s residential division (now Willow Bridge) has ranked on the NMHC 50 list every year since its debut in 1989.

sources.title: Our Promise | Our Mission
sources.excerpt:
Willow Bridge Property Company

Whether you’re an investor looking to expand your portfolio, a team player that is looking for career growth, or a person simply looking to start a new chapter in one of our apartment homes, Willow Bridge is here to support you. Our mission is to deliver impeccable service with integrity and give you the resources you need to thrive and feel empowered. Build a partnership with us today.

We act with our entire community in mind. Investors. Clients. Employees. Residents. Everyone has a role. We create the best resident experience, providing comfort like the iconic sheltering willow tree. We enable growth, community, and exchange like the suspension bridge that stands the test of time as a symbol of human ingenuity and drive. We do it because we care about building great relationships. With the cities, towns, and communities we belong to: we’re good corporate citizens. With clients and partners: we transform the trust and resources they place with us into growth that we can all benefit from. With the people who let us into their homes: we’re the best at service.

We are accountable for ensuring our neighbors are happy in their homes and take ownership of any problems that may arise.

evidence.title: About Us - RPM Living
evidence.text:
Debuted on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list at No. 42 with 38K units. In October, we acquired Phoenix-based Maverick Residential and opened the new Phoenix regional office, marking our westward expansion.

RPM Living is founded in Austin, Texas as Roscoe Property Management with just 10 units under management.

We are a highly innovative, full-service multifamily property management, investment and development company.

We are passionate about acquiring, building, and operating exceptional multifamily rental communities that build our investors’ confidence and satisfy our residents’ desires for sanctuary and home. Every day, we deliver hands-on property management service, strategic investment opportunities, and property development expertise no other professional real estate company of our size can match.

Jumped to No. 11 on the NMHC Top 50 Manager list with 81K units, the highest annual growth. In January, we acquired Dallas-based Pace Realty, expanding our verticals into student and senior living, and merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, furthering our footprint in the Southeast and Midwest.

RPM Living’s C-suite is composed of seasoned executives who lead with decades of professional experience in multifamily property management.

Our onsite leadership maintains the highest standards of service, responsiveness, and professionalism for successful multifamily property management.

evidence.text:
With over 240,000 units under management in 50+ submarkets and counting, RPM Living® is one of the largest and most successful vertically integrated multifamily management and investment firms in the country. The company footprint spans over 25+ states, with strategically placed corporate offices in Austin, Atlanta, and Phoenix.

RPM Living® maximizes property value with top industry talent, sophisticated multifamily management systems, and a proactive, hands-on, get-it-done approach.

Multifamily Management for a Broad Range of Property Types

With more than two decades of experience as one of the nation’s leading multifamily management companies, RPM Living® operates a wide variety of residential rental real estate in four vertical property types—conventional, senior, and affordable. Our professional managers are laser-focused on maintaining the highest property standards while maximizing NOI.

As a full-service multifamily property management company with more than 5,000+ experienced professionals in-market throughout 15 regions, RPM Living® has the knowledge, skills, and resources to provide comprehensive rental management services that make the most of your property investment and maximize your NOI.

At RPM Living®, our mission is to enhance client investments and create exceptional living environments for residents while operating to the highest ethical and business standards in multifamily management. We take the time to understand the unique value proposition of each property, collaborate with investors to determine measurable goals, and tailor hands-on rental management services to exceed them.

Find out how RPM Living® can help maximize the value of your investments through exceptional multifamily management. Contact us directly by submitting the form below.

Debuted on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list at No. 42 with 38K units. In October, we acquired Phoenix-based Maverick Residential and opened the new Phoenix regional office, marking our westward expansion.

RPM Living is founded in Austin, Texas as Roscoe Property Management with just 10 units under management.

We are a highly innovative, full-service multifamily property management, investment and development company.

We are passionate about acquiring, building, and operating exceptional multifamily rental communities that build our investors’ confidence and satisfy our residents’ desires for sanctuary and home. Every day, we deliver hands-on property management service, strategic investment opportunities, and property development expertise no other professional real estate company of our size can match.

Jumped to No. 11 on the NMHC Top 50 Manager list with 81K units, the highest annual growth. In January, we acquired Dallas-based Pace Realty, expanding our verticals into student and senior living, and merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, furthering our footprint in the Southeast and Midwest.

RPM Living’s C-suite is composed of seasoned executives who lead with decades of professional experience in multifamily property management.

Our onsite leadership maintains the highest standards of service, responsiveness, and professionalism for successful multifamily property management.

RPM Living Ranked #4 Largest Apartment Manager on NMHC's Top 50 List

Asset Living is the nation’s leader in true third-party property management with over 455K units from coast-to-coast.

With 40+ years of industry experience, we bring data-driven insights and knowledge to every community we manage and market we enter.

Our regional teams bring passion and expertise to deliver management solutions that lead your property to success.

Proudly challenging the limits of what property management can accomplish.

evidence.title: Asset Living | Multifamily Property Management
evidence.text:
2016 No task is too large or too complicated for team Asset. After being awarded management of the CCG Portfolio, our team seamlessly transitioned 74 properties inclusive of 42,000 beds over a 45-day period.

2011 Team Asset is recognized as an industry leader in property management ranked as No. 1 on SHB’s Top Managers List, No. 34 on NMHC’s Top Managers List, and ending the year with 34,000 units.

Proudly managing over 2,700 communities nationwide.

Our unwavering commitment to excellence has secured us the No. 2 spot on NMHC’s Top 50 Manager List for multifamily living.

We deliver comprehensive property management services across a diverse range of communities.

2020 Broadened our affordable property management portfolio while simultaneously growing our multi-family presence in the Southwest following the acquisition of Alpha Barnes Real Estate Services and Shelton Residential.

The Charles, a multifamily community in Destin, FL, faced early lease-up challenges due to ongoing construction delays and non-operational amenities during its first year. To maintain resident satisfaction and protect the property’s online reputation, the Asset Living team implemented proactive communication strategies, a Virtual Leasing Concierge, and a strong lineup of community engagement initiatives. These efforts helped foster a boutique-style living experience, supported by consistent resident touchpoints and timely service delivery. With an average of 50 attendees per resident event and a sub-24-hour work order completion rate, The Charles successfully built a positive, service-driven community culture amid a difficult start.

“It’s hard to narrow down just one favorite memory as I had no idea the opportunities being an Asset Ambassador would provide me over the last few years. However, I am currently most proud of my 2023 Property Manager of the Year award with the First Coast Apartment Association in Jacksonville, FL. This award was more of a team award because I would not have been able to hit all my goals without them.”

UDR’s portfolio strategy is driven by a commitment to growth, innovation, and sustainability. A strategic approach to uncovering and unlocking value within well-located apartment communities across growing markets, the Redevelopment Program targets underperforming or overlooked assets with strong potential—applying capital improvements and rebranding strategies that enhance property performance, reposition assets in their markets, and drive NOI and long-term returns. Design upgrades are aligned with market demand, with a consistent focus on elevating the resident experience and ensuring operational excellence.

Avenue5 provides professional property management services for over 825 multifamily and single-family properties for rent across the United States. We’re based in Seattle and proud to create warm and inviting living experiences for residents nationwide.

Whether you're looking for top-rated apartments for rent, custom property management services, or a growth-driven career in multifamily real estate, we bring more to your life.

That’s why we’re one of the best multifamily property management companies in the nation.

“We love living here. The management team in place now is fantastic! The building is beautiful and our home has the best view! Sometimes when I walk into my apartment and see the sun setting over forest park I have to pinch myself!” Resident at The Century

MHN’S TOP 5O MULTIFAMILY MANAGEMENT COMPANIES IN 2025

Our expert insights and custom strategies add value for property owners, and our commitment to associate growth has earned us a Great Place to Work® certification each year since 2017.

Hire Our Team Explore Avenue5 property management services and learn about our proven track record.

“The Management Team have shown me to be professional, caring and considerate individuals that are on top of what is needed to run such a large complex as Chapel Hills. My hat is off to them.” Resident at The Crossings at Chapel Hill

evidence.title: Our Story | Avenue5 Residential
evidence.text:
We expanded our property management services to the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions, and we earned recognition from the Puget Sound Business Journal as one of the 100 fastest-growing private companies in our home state of Washington. By the end of the year, we proudly managed over 18,000 units.

We entered the year with more than 75,000 units and 150 clients, holding strong at number 15 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. Multi-Housing News (MHN) ranked us number seven on their Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list and number six on their Fastest Growing Property Management Companies list. Our CEO, Walt Smith, received a Lifetime Achievement Award from the Washington Multifamily Housing Association. We also earned our fifth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification thanks to accolades from our associates.

We crossed a defining milestone: 100,000 units under management, achieved entirely through organic growth. We moved up to number 12 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list, ranked number eight on MHN’s Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list, and earned our sixth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification in recognition of positive feedback from associates.

Our scale and recognition continued to reach new heights. We advanced to number eight on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list and held the number seven position on MHN’s Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list. We grew to 3,000 associates and more than 140,000 units across 20 states and Washington, D.C. Studio5, our in-house creative agency, earned a 2024 Muse Award for its branding work on Altair by Soltura. We also achieved our eighth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

With more than 300 properties and 55,000 units under management, we rose to number 20 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. Thanks to our associates’ continued positive feedback about the #FiverLife, we also earned our third consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

evidence.title: Our Story | Avenue5 Residential
evidence.text:
We continued our expansion, surpassing 67,000 units and advancing to number 15 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. We also deepened our impact by launching REACH at 5, our diversity, equity, and inclusion collective, and introducing our environmental, social, and governance (ESG) platform. We earned our fourth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

Committed to putting an end to autopilot in the multifamily industry, we launched Avenue5 with a fresh, hands-on, and customized approach to third-party property management. Centered on performance success, bolstered by our five core beliefs, and strengthened by a collaborative and inclusive culture, we began building relationships with multifamily owners seeking expertise, precision, and measurable results.

We advanced to position number 30 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list and were recognized as the second fastest-growing company in Washington by the Puget Sound Business Journal. For the second consecutive year, we earned a Great Place to Work® certification. We also earned a position on the Best Places to Work in Multifamily list for the first time.

sources.title: Our Story | Avenue5 Residential
sources.excerpt:
We expanded our property management services to the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions, and we earned recognition from the Puget Sound Business Journal as one of the 100 fastest-growing private companies in our home state of Washington. By the end of the year, we proudly managed over 18,000 units.

We entered the year with more than 75,000 units and 150 clients, holding strong at number 15 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. Multi-Housing News (MHN) ranked us number seven on their Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list and number six on their Fastest Growing Property Management Companies list. Our CEO, Walt Smith, received a Lifetime Achievement Award from the Washington Multifamily Housing Association. We also earned our fifth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification thanks to accolades from our associates.

We crossed a defining milestone: 100,000 units under management, achieved entirely through organic growth. We moved up to number 12 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list, ranked number eight on MHN’s Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list, and earned our sixth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification in recognition of positive feedback from associates.

Our scale and recognition continued to reach new heights. We advanced to number eight on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list and held the number seven position on MHN’s Top Multifamily Property Management Firms list. We grew to 3,000 associates and more than 140,000 units across 20 states and Washington, D.C. Studio5, our in-house creative agency, earned a 2024 Muse Award for its branding work on Altair by Soltura. We also achieved our eighth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

With more than 300 properties and 55,000 units under management, we rose to number 20 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. Thanks to our associates’ continued positive feedback about the #FiverLife, we also earned our third consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

We continued our expansion, surpassing 67,000 units and advancing to number 15 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list. We also deepened our impact by launching REACH at 5, our diversity, equity, and inclusion collective, and introducing our environmental, social, and governance (ESG) platform. We earned our fourth consecutive Great Place to Work® certification.

Committed to putting an end to autopilot in the multifamily industry, we launched Avenue5 with a fresh, hands-on, and customized approach to third-party property management. Centered on performance success, bolstered by our five core beliefs, and strengthened by a collaborative and inclusive culture, we began building relationships with multifamily owners seeking expertise, precision, and measurable results.

We advanced to position number 30 on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list and were recognized as the second fastest-growing company in Washington by the Puget Sound Business Journal. For the second consecutive year, we earned a Great Place to Work® certification. We also earned a position on the Best Places to Work in Multifamily list for the first time.

evidence.text:
From Georgia to Maryland, our portfolio has grown to over 8,000 apartment homes. With a focus on our customers, we have remained at the forefront of building and managing apartment communities offering resort-style amenities and features you would find in a custom home. We promise to provide our residents and communities with quality products and unparalleled customer service!

Find your new apartment home at HHHunt Apartment Living.

New apartment communities offering resort-style amenities

Our apartment homes are designed with you in mind. Our focus is on YOU the customer, and we strive to find new ways to exceed your expectations.

Our new apartment communities offer resort-style amenities like swimming pools, clubhouses, state-of-the-art fitness centers, dog parks, EV charging stations and business centers.

Whether you’re looking for a modern vibe or relaxed charm, North Carolina checks all your boxes. With its capital city of Raleigh emerging as a hub of technology, this state offers unique career opportunities, sporting events, culture and so much more! Find your new apartment home in North Carolina today.

Offering an exciting lifestyle, South Carolina is filled with warm hospitality, culture and fun! With vibrant historical districts, sandy beaches, and beautiful state parks, your activity calendar is planned years in advance. Enjoy our award-winning apartment communities in multiple locations in this amazing state!

If you are looking for all four seasons in a state that offers both beaches and mountains, then Virginia has you covered. Rooted in rich history, this state offers its residents a beautiful rural landscape blended with a culture of multiple charming downtowns like its capital city, Richmond. We invite you to find your apartment home today!

evidence.title: Customer Focused | Smart Home Technology for Apartment Living Residents
evidence.text:
HHHunt opened its first apartment community in 1966 in Blacksburg, VA. Today, HHHunt Apartment Living owns and manages over 8,600 apartment homes in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia and Maryland. The company is at the forefront of innovation in multifamily development and management with communities that boast superb locations, spacious apartments and luxury amenities. To learn more about HHHunt Apartment Living, visit https://www.hhhuntapartmentliving.com. If you’re looking for an exciting career opportunity, visit us at https://www.hhhunt.com/career-opportunities.com.

HHHunt’s Apartment Living division partnered with Everon, a leading security integrator, to introduce a smart home technology package in over 7,700 apartment homes across the Southeast.

The benefits of smart apartment technology extend beyond the residents. By integrating with HHHunt’s property management system, these solutions help improve community operations and everyday workflow for our team members.

Many HHHunt communities feature smart home technology, including smart locks, smart thermostats, smart home hubs, monitored alarms and mobile app controls that allow residents to manage their homes remotely. Visit the “Amenities” section of your specific community’s website to learn more about available features.

The smart home package combines smart locks, smart thermostats and smart home hubs to give residents greater control over their homes. Designed to benefit both residents and on-site teams, this technology helps simplify everyday tasks, streamline community operations and support the exceptional service residents love about HHHunt.

Today’s renters increasingly value convenience, flexibility, peace of mind and the ability to manage their homes remotely. Smart home technology helps meet these expectations while creating a more personalized living experience.

Customer Focused | SmartHome Technology for Apartment Living Residents

The Future of Apartment Living is Smart

sources.title: Apartment Homes Across the Southeast • HHHunt Apartment Living
sources.excerpt:
From Georgia to Maryland, our portfolio has grown to over 8,000 apartment homes. With a focus on our customers, we have remained at the forefront of building and managing apartment communities offering resort-style amenities and features you would find in a custom home. We promise to provide our residents and communities with quality products and unparalleled customer service!

Find your new apartment home at HHHunt Apartment Living.

New apartment communities offering resort-style amenities

Our apartment homes are designed with you in mind. Our focus is on YOU the customer, and we strive to find new ways to exceed your expectations.

Our new apartment communities offer resort-style amenities like swimming pools, clubhouses, state-of-the-art fitness centers, dog parks, EV charging stations and business centers.

Whether you’re looking for a modern vibe or relaxed charm, North Carolina checks all your boxes. With its capital city of Raleigh emerging as a hub of technology, this state offers unique career opportunities, sporting events, culture and so much more! Find your new apartment home in North Carolina today.

Offering an exciting lifestyle, South Carolina is filled with warm hospitality, culture and fun! With vibrant historical districts, sandy beaches, and beautiful state parks, your activity calendar is planned years in advance. Enjoy our award-winning apartment communities in multiple locations in this amazing state!

If you are looking for all four seasons in a state that offers both beaches and mountains, then Virginia has you covered. Rooted in rich history, this state offers its residents a beautiful rural landscape blended with a culture of multiple charming downtowns like its capital city, Richmond. We invite you to find your apartment home today!

sources.title: Customer Focused | Smart Home Technology for Apartment Living Residents
sources.excerpt:
HHHunt opened its first apartment community in 1966 in Blacksburg, VA. Today, HHHunt Apartment Living owns and manages over 8,600 apartment homes in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia and Maryland. The company is at the forefront of innovation in multifamily development and management with communities that boast superb locations, spacious apartments and luxury amenities. To learn more about HHHunt Apartment Living, visit https://www.hhhuntapartmentliving.com. If you’re looking for an exciting career opportunity, visit us at https://www.hhhunt.com/career-opportunities.com.

HHHunt’s Apartment Living division partnered with Everon, a leading security integrator, to introduce a smart home technology package in over 7,700 apartment homes across the Southeast.

The benefits of smart apartment technology extend beyond the residents. By integrating with HHHunt’s property management system, these solutions help improve community operations and everyday workflow for our team members.

Many HHHunt communities feature smart home technology, including smart locks, smart thermostats, smart home hubs, monitored alarms and mobile app controls that allow residents to manage their homes remotely. Visit the “Amenities” section of your specific community’s website to learn more about available features.

The smart home package combines smart locks, smart thermostats and smart home hubs to give residents greater control over their homes. Designed to benefit both residents and on-site teams, this technology helps simplify everyday tasks, streamline community operations and support the exceptional service residents love about HHHunt.

Today’s renters increasingly value convenience, flexibility, peace of mind and the ability to manage their homes remotely. Smart home technology helps meet these expectations while creating a more personalized living experience.

Customer Focused | SmartHome Technology for Apartment Living Residents

The Future of Apartment Living is Smart

evidence.title: S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation's Top Multifamily Property Management Companies | S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co.
evidence.text:
The recognition highlights S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co.’s continued growth and strength as a multifamily management leader. With a portfolio of more than 32,000 apartment homes managed throughout the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast, the company has built a reputation for operational excellence, exceptional resident experiences, and long-term value creation for property owners.

Who We Are |&nbsp Newsroom |&nbsp S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

NORFOLK, VA (August 2026) – S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. is proud to announce that it has been ranked No. 34 nationally in Multi-Housing News’ 2026 ranking of the Top Multifamily Property Management Companies, placing the firm among the largest and most respected multifamily management organizations in the United States. The annual ranking recognizes the country’s leading property management companies based on a range of factors, including units under management, portfolio performance, growth, and market presence.

“The steady growth of our portfolio is due largely to the loyalty and trust of our many long-term clients, as well as our extraordinary corporate, regional, and onsite employees,” said Steve Boyce, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations.

Published by Multi-Housing News, the 2026 ranking evaluated 65 of the nation’s leading multifamily management firms. Collectively, these companies manage more than 4.1 million apartment units across approximately 18,800 communities nationwide, demonstrating the scale and competitiveness of the industry’s top performers.

“Being named among the top multifamily property management companies in the nation is a tremendous honor and a reflection of the dedication of our associates across every market we serve,” said Aaron Wyatt, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations. “For more than a century, our company has remained committed to delivering outstanding service, fostering vibrant communities, and helping our clients achieve their investment goals. This recognition underscores the strength of our team and the trust our residents and ownership partners place in us every day.”

NORFOLK, VA (August 2026) – S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. is proud to announce that it has been ranked No. 34 nationally in Multi-Housing News’ 2026 ranking of the Top Multifamily Property Management Companies, placing the firm among the largest and most respected multifamily management organizations in the United States. Published by Multi-Housing News, the 2026 ranking evaluated 65 of the nation’s leading multifamily management firms. Collectively, these companies manage more than 4.1 million apartment units across approximately 18,800 communities nationwide, demonstrating the scale and competitiveness of the industry’s top performers.

“Being named among the top multifamily property management companies in the nation is a tremendous honor and a reflection of the dedication of our associates across every market we serve,” said Aaron Wyatt, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations. “For more than a century, our company has remained committed to delivering outstanding service, fostering vibrant communities, and helping our clients achieve their investment goals. This recognition underscores the strength of our team and the trust our residents and ownership partners place in us every day.”

As the multifamily industry continues to evolve, S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. remains committed to leveraging innovation, operational expertise, and personalized service to deliver best-in-class management solutions and strengthen the communities it serves.

At Nestwell Property Management, we help Utah property owners simplify rental ownership, protect their investments, and create better experiences for both owners and residents.

With more than 40 years of combined real estate and property management experience, our team provides full-service property management solutions designed to reduce stress, minimize vacancies, and improve long-term property performance throughout Utah.

From single-family homes and condos to multi-unit rental properties, we manage every aspect of the rental process with a focus on transparency, responsiveness, and local market expertise.

Whether you own one rental home or a growing investment portfolio, our goal is simple: help you maximize your property’s potential while we handle the day-to-day management.

Managing rental properties in Utah requires more than collecting rent and coordinating repairs. It requires a deep understanding of local rental markets, tenant expectations, property maintenance, leasing strategies, and Utah landlord-tenant regulations. We work to help owners stay competitive in Utah’s evolving rental market while protecting the value of their investments.

Our mission is to provide dependable, professional property management services that help Utah property owners succeed while creating positive rental experiences for residents.

evidence.title: Homes for Rent in North Carolina / Acorn & Oak
evidence.text:
My wife and I moved to the area and decided to rent from Acorn and Oak Property Management because of the good reviews online. They did not disappoint. Whenever we had any trouble with our rental property, Acorn and Oak always sent someone out promptly to check out the problem. The portal is very easy to use the the staff are great to interact with (we worked with Laurie and Nicole and they were super). I would highly recommend choosing to rent from Acorn and Oak.

Acorn + Oak managed our rental property while we lived out-of-state. We had an excellent experience with them. We were kept informed of issues (e.g., leaky washer, new renter applications, etc.), but always had faith that everything was professionally and efficiently handled. They also have a user-friendly online portal where you can access monthly reports, tax documents, etc. We worked with Daniel Woodward, and he was phenomenal--quick, transparent communication and always on top of it. We cannot say enough good things about working with Acorn + Oak if you are looking to rent property!

The acorn and the oak have long been symbols of growth, strength, and prosperity. Legend has it that an oak branch or acorn placed inside a living space helps protect the home and its occupants. It is in this spirit that Acorn + Oak Property Management planted our own roots in North Carolina in 2013. Today we manage a growing roster of single-family homes and small multi-unit complexes throughout Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill and the surrounding cities.

We had reached out to a few different property management companies before our friends helped us find Acorn + Oak. When you are renting your home you want it to be in good hands and with people who make you feel heard. Ariel from Acorn + Oak listened and respected what was important to us--never pressuring us into anything and always valuing our opinion. They have been great at communicating, getting the home ready quickly, finding multiple quotes, and so impressively always one step ahead and on top of everything. Very grateful to be working with this company!

evidence.title: Superior Property Management in NC: Acorn & Oak
evidence.text:
Since our launch in 2013, Acorn + Oak has been fortunate enough to grow from zero to over 2,200 units under management. Our success has everything to do with the quality of service we're dedicated to providing and by following the Golden Rule - treating others how we'd like to be treated.

Whether you’re being relocated to Tokyo or live right around the corner from your rental property, Acorn + Oak can help. We work with all types of property owners: Investment groups, solo real estate investors, the homeowner whose job is moving them out of state next week, and even the “reluctant landlord” whose home has been up for sale for 6 months. Whatever your background, wherever you live, we’ll look after your property as if it was our own.

We're much more than status quo. Acorn + Oak was created to be a different kind of property management company. One that valued relationships with both our clients and tenants, refused to cut corners, and dedicated everyday to delivering customer service that knocks your socks off.

We're committed to providing our tenants with an excellent experience which produces happier residents, longer tenancies, and better care of the homes we manage. Everybody wins.

evidence.title: San Francisco Property Management - Gordon Property Management
evidence.text:
Renting out property in San Francisco is more complex than ever. With new laws, new market trends, and new risk, the leasing and management process requires an experienced, professional property management team.

Gordon Property Management has managed single family homes and multi-unit residential apartment buildings in San Francisco since 1987. We’re dedicated to providing property management San Francisco owners and tenants trust.

From leasing to management to maintenance, the talented team at Gordon Property Management protects the condition, value, and profitability of your investments. You deserve better peace of mind.

Our San Francisco property management leadership extends to understanding the numerous local, state, and federal laws which affect the rental housing industry.

How can tenant credit scores help owners select and place qualified residents in their San Francisco properties? This is a competitive, highly regulated rental market, and tenant credit scores are an important metric. In fact, among all the variables property owners...

All our employees have completed the San Francisco’s Apartment Association CCRM courses, which covers San Francisco’s Rent Control Ordinance, fair housing laws, and essential landlord/tenant best practices. The San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance has unfortunately turned the landlord/tenant relationship into something that’s potentially adversarial. It doesn’t have to be that way, and while some tenants can be a challenge – we believe in treating everyone fairly and consistently so your experience as a landlord is positive and profitable.

Our high standards, industry leadership and excellent customer service set us apart from other property management companies.

Working with San Francisco owners in The Mission District, The Marina, Mission Bay, Pacific Heights, Noe Valley + surrounding areas.

evidence.title: About Us | Gordon Property Management in San Francisco
evidence.text:
San Francisco is a unique rental market. Landlords need to navigate the San Francisco Rent Control Ordinance, new fair housing regulations, and a vast range in rental prices. Your success depends on expert property management. We perform at a higher level than other companies.

At Gordon Property Management, we are leasing agents and property managers. We are maintenance professionals and administrative specialists. We are committed to making your experience better.

Extraordinary San Francisco Property Management

Property management is our only business. We lease homes and apartments, we manage properties, and we consult with owners on how to increase the returns on their investments. You can expect our team to be professional, responsive, and proactive. We bring innovative thinking to every system, and we are constantly improving processes to make them more efficient.

Since 1987, we have been successfully providing San Francisco property management for investors like you. We know that your property is unique and your goals are significant. The management plan we craft for you will reflect who you are, what you want, and why you’re here.

At Gordon Property Management, we strive to find a balance between serving our property owner clients, and our tenants who need high quality housing. Our primary responsibility is to the property owners we work with, and we know from experience that providing our tenants with reliable service benefits our owners as well as our tenants. Responsiveness to maintenance leads to lower turnover rates and respectful communication brings us better relationships.

As you look for San Francisco property management services, choose an expert who can protect your asset and ensure a healthy return on your investment.

Nanette Barr Property Manager DRE License #01929355

Every investment property is unique. We create a custom San Francisco property management plan for your investment, whether it’s a single unit or a portfolio of buildings. Count on us for high quality leasing, management, and maintenance services that are legally compliant and designed to earn you more in rent and ROI.

Smart investors know that hiring a professional property management company to lease, manage, and maintain their rental investments makes financial and practical sense. But, you have to choose the right company. You have to select a property management partner who understands your unique investment goals and your property’s place in the market.

San Francisco Property Management Services

Gordon Property Management leads the local San Francisco management industry.

Property Management Services Owners and Investors Trust

Our marketing is targeted and effective because the San Francisco property management market is competitive. We use professional photographers, online advertising, our own website, and our connections within the San Francisco community to attract potential tenants.

We screen for credit, criminal, and eviction backgrounds, and talk to former landlords to ensure we only hand over the keys to tenants who follow the terms of the lease and take good care of a home. Our thoroughness sets us apart from other San Francisco property management companies.

This type of rental arrangement provides a blend of the convenience of short-term rentals with some of the operational effectiveness of a long term rental. Additionally, the pricing is often at a sizable premium over the typical 12 month long term tenant. evidence.text:
A "mid-term" rental typically refers to a rental arrangement that lasts from one month to a year, bridging the gap between short-term vacation rentals and long-term leases. Unlike short-term rentals, which often cater to tourists or vacationers for stays of a few days to weeks, mid-term rentals are designed for individuals or families seeking temporary housing for a more extended period. This type of rental is popular among professionals on temporary assignments (think business executives, traveling nurses), people relocating and searching for a permanent home to buy (maybe someone waiting for their new home to be built), or insurance related issues where someone's home has been affected by fire, flood, etc and needs to be vacated and extensively repaired. The flexibility in lease duration provides an attractive alternative for those who need more stability than short-term options but are not ready for the commitment of a long-term lease. A "mid-term" rental typically refers to a rental arrangement that lasts from one month to a year, bridging the gap between short-term vacation rentals and long-term leases. Unlike short-term rentals, which often cater to tourists or vacationers for stays of a few days to weeks, mid-term rentals are designed for individuals or families seeking temporary housing for a more extended period. This type of rental is popular among professionals on temporary assignments (think business executives, traveling nurses), people relocating and searching for a permanent home to buy (maybe someone waiting for their new home to be built), or insurance related issues where someone's home has been affected by fire, flood, etc and needs to be vacated and extensively repaired. The flexibility in lease duration provides an attractive alternative for those who need more stability than short-term options but are not ready for the commitment of a long-term lease. Partner with Keyrenter to Manage Your Rental Property with No Hidden Fees.

Effortless Property Management. Maximized Returns.

Let’s take the stress out of property ownership.

Our team handles lease violations, tenant disputes, and, if necessary, the eviction process—always with compliance and care.

sources.title: Property Management Services Richmond VA | Real Property Management Richmond Metro
sources.quote:
Real Property Management’s professional services include ongoing communication, comprehensive marketing, and advertising, thorough tenant screening and selection, full-service leasing, timely rent collection, regular property reviews, cost-effective and reliable maintenance, strict and compliant evictions, and comprehensive accounting.

Real Property Management makes every effort to keep you informed about your property. A secure online account provided by our team keeps you updated on property activity, including vacancies, leasing, maintenance, property reviews and financial reports. Whether you live a few blocks from your rental property or hundreds of miles away, you can monitor the activity of your property from the convenience of your computer, 24 hours a day anywhere in the world.

Each day that your property is vacant is money out of your pocket. Professional management costs are easily offset by shorter vacancy times. We spend thousands of dollars every month advertising our vacancies to get them filled – faster. Your property is advertised on high-traffic rental and classified websites. A professional “For Rent” yard sign adds exposure to capture drive-by prospective tenants. Our experienced leasing agents respond promptly to inquiries and advise prospective tenants on details about the property, and show your home in the best possible light.

Placing the wrong tenant can quickly cost you what you may save by managing a property yourself. Every tenant application is evaluated based on credit, background, employment verification and residency/rental history. Our thorough screening complies with all applicable laws, including Fair Housing and Fair Credit Reporting Act.

Your leasing agent manages the lease signing with the approved tenant, using our professionally prepared lease, and ensures that all proper contracts are executed correctly. At the same time, rents, deposits and any fees are collected in accordance with local legal and financial regulations, and recorded to your online account. We also provide professional tenant education at lease signing.

Maintenance is a necessary expense in owning a rental property, and the return on your investment can be significantly impacted without timely, cost-effective repairs and upkeep. When handled by us, you’ll save time and money and ensure repairs are completed in a professional manner, by trustworthy maintenance personnel.

Our goal is to maximize your income and minimize your expenses. To keep track of your income and expenses we use a centralized accounting system. This all-inclusive accounting and reporting system, backed with itemized statements and tax documentation, keeps all your property management financial information organized in one place.

Real Property Management Richmond Metro provides each property owner client a password-protected online account for easy access to financial reports any time you need.

evidence.text:
"As we push into a centralized leasing model, we've had to be very intentional about our software stack. Our decentralized operating model covers 25,000 units. For this, we needed a strong partner who could quickly turn around integrations and essentially be a partner for us as we pioneer this new operating model.”

ResMan’s industry-leading property management platform helps multifamily and affordable housing managers operate more efficiently and deliver higher rates of return to investors.

"ResMan has all the information we need housed within it. I don’t need to go anywhere to get our accounting or our leasing. It’s all together so we’re able to look at operations and financials at the same time from the same system. We don’t have to pull data out and build spreadsheets. You don’t get this with any other property management system."

Leading Property Management Companies Trust ResMan

Multifamily Property Management Software

Manage your business and operate your conventional multifamily properties more efficiently with this modern, open property management platform designed from within the industry to help you deliver more NOI.

Manage HUD (including RAD conversions), Rural Development, Tax Credit and state and local rental assistance programs more efficiently and cost effectively with the industry’s leading Affordable Housing compliance solution.​

Derek Lehn, Controller at Mark-Taylor, shares how their 25,000+ units operate efficiently with ResMan, especially in the back office. “ResMan, especially from the accounting perspective, is built for ease of use,” Derek says.

evidence.title: HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations
evidence.text:
Using HappyCo’s integrated suite of centralized maintenance solutions and services, Blanton Turner has cut unit turns from 12-14 days to 5.7 on average, with each technician now managing 150-175 units. These gains – echoed by customers like Anchor NW Property Group – break through industry benchmarks, with other operators seeing up to 60% after-hour call deflection.

What results have multifamily operators achieved using HappyCo's AI-powered maintenance platform? Operators using HappyCo's integrated maintenance solutions have achieved measurable results including: unit turn times reduced from 12-14 days to 5.7 days average (Blanton Turner), technicians managing 150-175 units each (up from industry average), and up to 60% after-hour call deflection across customer portfolios.

Serving over 50,000 multifamily property leaders across 5.5 million units, HappyCo integrates with major property management systems, including Yardi, MRI Software, RealPage, Entrata, and ResMan. Its open API marketplace enables single-click access to a growing network of prop-tech partners.

FrOM THE Newsroom HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations Learn More

San Diego HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations

San Diego CA – November 13, 2025 – HappyCo, a leading provider of maintenance operations software for the multifamily real estate sector, today debuted Voice Assist – AI-powered voice capture that transforms field observations into automated workflows and predictive intelligence.‍

“Maintenance data doesn’t stop at the work order,” said Dan Regan, Director of Integrated Operations at Mark-Taylor Residential. “Completion notes are critical for us to assess service quality and identify whether issues stem from technician performance or equipment failure. That visibility drives our preventive maintenance strategy. HappyCo captures consistent documentation that reveals patterns for smarter capital planning.”

How much can maintenance documentation cost multifamily operators? Poor maintenance documentation increases unplanned repair costs by up to 40%. First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: FR) is a leading U.S.-only owner, operator, developer and acquirer of logistics properties. Through our fully integrated operating and investing platform, we provide high quality facilities and industry-leading customer service to multinational corporations and regional firms that are essential for their supply chains. In total, we own and have under development approximately 72.1 million square feet of industrial space concentrated in 15 target MSAs as of June 30, 2026.

Over 30 years as a public company focused on top U.S. industrial markets
